purpose: Package the completed project-owned Morales-Ramis reproduction, spatial/KS transfer, bounded WP3 null result, and WP1 follow-on map into a claim-bounded manuscript and independently reproducible evidence release.
publication_title: Exact reproduction and KS-atlas transfer of a Morales-Ramis obstruction near the parabolic Lagrange solution
primary_result: The project-owned WP4-MR-REPL-v1 planar obstruction transfers to the translation-reduced spatial positive-mass Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian: it is not completely integrable by meromorphic first integrals near the embedded fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum parabolic Lagrange phase curve. Consequently, the qualified WP2-MULTIQ-v1 atlas admits no complete shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family on any domain containing that regular neighborhood.
prior_art_policy: The planar local meromorphic complete-integrability obstruction is attributed to Tsygvintsev and to Boucher-Weil, with the Morales-Ramis theorem as its Galoisian foundation. WP5 may claim an exact project-owned reproduction, explicit convention equivalence, qualification, and the separately proved spatial/KS transfer. It may not claim discovery or novelty of the published planar theorem before independent literature review.

context_policy.wp1: WP1-CAT-N3BP-v1 and WP1-RESIDUAL-MAP-v1 are bounded computational context and future-work allocation. They are not evidence for the nonintegrability theorem.
context_policy.wp2: WP2-MULTIQ-v1 supplies the exact qualified KS atlas consumed by the transfer theorem. Its exclusions remain in force.
context_policy.wp3: WP3-MULTI-CAND-v2-KQ-v1 is a bounded null result only in its frozen 285-function library after quotienting the known L^2 class. It is not a no-integral theorem and is not used to prove WP4.
context_policy.legacy: The disjoint legacy baseline is software-regression and portability evidence only. Quarantined historical prototypes have no publication claim authority.

scientific_source_manifest.policy: Primary papers are cited and compared by hash; they are not redistributed.

required_statements: The planar theorem is a reproduction of published work, not an asserted original discovery.
The WP3 result is bounded to its frozen library and is not used in the proof.
The theorem concerns complete meromorphic Liouville integrability locally near one phase curve.
The result does not exclude one additional integral.
The KS consequence requires shell regularity, zero Xi, gauge projectability, chart compatibility, and clock independence.
forbidden_unqualified_phrases: the three-body problem has no integrals
global nonintegrability of the three-body problem
complete search of all possible integrals
manuscript_requirements.format: Venue-neutral PDFLaTeX using only arXiv-supported standard packages, with all bibliography inputs included and a visually inspected PDF.

internal_gates: The specification lock and every prerequisite hash verify.
Every required artifact exists and is included in a canonical SHA-256 manifest.
The manuscript theorem and abstract conform to the claim ledger.
Every theorem dependency has a path to an immutable PASS record or a primary source.
The prior-art and bounded-WP3 policies are stated explicitly.
The source-disjoint generic derivation reruns and exactly matches the frozen payload after excluding elapsed time.
All publication-specific tests and adversarial controls pass.
The LaTeX source compiles without errors and the rendered PDF passes visual inspection.
The one-command reproducer succeeds from a clean checkout.
No external-review evidence is fabricated or inferred.

external_gates.human_reviews: Two distinct, consenting human reviewers independent of the author and implementation chain are required. Collectively they must cover differential-Galois/planar mathematics and symplectic-reduction/KS-transfer mathematics.
external_gates.clean_room_reproduction: At least one reviewer or separate independent person must execute the frozen core reproducer outside project-controlled hardware and submit a receipt pinning the commit and artifact manifest.
external_gates.findings: No blocker or unresolved major finding may remain.
external_gates.author_metadata: Author name, affiliation status, contact, contribution statement, conflicts, funding, ORCID status, and AI-assistance disclosure must be explicitly confirmed by the author.
external_gates.licenses: The author must choose and record licenses for code, data/evidence, and manuscript text.
external_gates.release_authorization: Preprint submission and archival release require explicit author authorization.

negative_controls: Replace the local complete-meromorphic-integrability obstruction with a no-integrals claim.
Remove the fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum or neighborhood restriction.
Use the bounded WP3 null result as proof of nonintegrability.
Describe the published planar theorem as a project discovery or first proof.
Accept status-only predecessor records without exact hashes.
Accept a source PDF or proof whose hash changed.
Accept an internally generated, AI-generated, anonymous, or self-authored review as independent human review.
Accept a clean-room receipt from project-controlled hardware.
Authorize submission with unconfirmed author metadata or licenses.
Accept a PDF that is not reproducible from the frozen manuscript source.
Accept a generic symbolic replay that matches only its final status rather than its complete decision-bearing payload.

decision_policy.FAIL: Any integrity mismatch, manuscript overclaim, missing required internal artifact, derivation disagreement, failed adversarial control, or unresolved internal blocker fails the campaign.
decision_policy.READY_FOR_EXTERNAL_REVIEW: Every internal gate passes, but one or more external, author, license, archive, or release-authorization gates remain unsatisfied.
decision_policy.READY_FOR_SUBMISSION: Every internal gate and all independent human review, external clean-room, finding-resolution, author-metadata, and license gates pass; explicit release authorization may still be pending.
decision_policy.PUBLISHED: READY_FOR_SUBMISSION holds, the author explicitly authorizes release, and immutable preprint and software-archive identifiers pin the qualified commit.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SHORT_CLAIM: The three-body problem has no integrals.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_NOVELTY_CLAIM: The project discovered or first proved the published planar nonintegrability theorem.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_GLOBAL_CLAIM: The local phase-curve obstruction covers every phase-space domain, every trajectory, or every regularity class.

invalidation: Any changed scientific prerequisite, source manifest, theorem wording, review rule, artifact requirement, negative control, or decision rule invalidates WP5-PUB-v1 and requires a successor.
